name: JobShifu
summary: AI job-search agent that finds roles on 14,000+ employer career sites, tailors your resume from confirmed experience, and helps fill applications.
description: AI job-search agent that finds roles on 14,000+ employer career sites, tailors your resume from confirmed experience, and helps fill applications.

pricing.details: Free forever, no card. JobShifu Pro launch price 27 €/month until 31 December 2026, then 36 €/month for new monthly subscribers (existing launch-price subscribers keep their rate, as stated). Quarterly 67 € / 3 months; Yearly 214 €/year; one-time Week Pass 13 € for 7 days of Pro, no auto-renewal.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Job search across 14,000+ employer career sites
Resume tailoring from confirmed experience, plus application tracking
Free tier with no credit card
Launch price on monthly Pro until 31 December 2026
